sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop, 7 frames): a hunched charge, an axe in each hand, the arms pumping, the beard and the hair bouncing, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE TWO AXES go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): a silver-headed axe in each hand, as big as in image 1 - raised overhead, swung, slammed down, crossed or flung out as the pale figure holds them; where the pale figure's hand is empty (after Q's throw), draw no axe in it. Only him: no flying axe, no slashes, no red rage glow, no frost.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his brown fur-topped boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: PASSING: the FAR leg passing forward right beside the planted near leg, its foot just off the ground - the two feet side by side. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-3 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 4-7 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 4 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the arms and the axes follow the pale figure. The fur round his boots is NOT a third foot: his two legs carry him.
